sentences.en: I couldn't print the handouts because the printer wasn't working.
sentences.zh: 打印机坏了，所以我没法打印这些传单。

sentences.en: The teacher distributed the handouts to the students.
sentences.zh: 老师把传单分发给了学生们。

sentences.en: The class handouts on human growth and development include anatomically correct drawings.
sentences.zh: 关于人类生长和发展的课堂传单包含有解剖学准确的插图。
